title: Salesforce Solution Architect
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned Salesforce Technical Architect to lead the Salesforce team for a key customer account. The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in Salesforce Solution Architecture, strong technical expertise in key Salesforce products, and the ability to drive strategic initiatives and deliver technical excellence.
  
  
**Responsibilities & Tasks**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Architecture:
* Design scalable and maintainable Salesforce solutions that meet customer business requirements.
* Develop solution blueprints encompassing Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service Lightning, and custom development.
* Conduct requirements workshops, translating business needs into technical specifications.
* Technical Leadership:
* Guide the development and configuration of Salesforce components, including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and integrations.
* Provide oversight on all phases of project implementation, ensuring delivery aligns with best practices and quality standards.
* Lead technical troubleshooting and optimization efforts for Salesforce solutions.
* Customer Collaboration:
* Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, understanding their goals and challenges.
* Recommend innovative Salesforce capabilities to improve operational efficiency and user adoption.
* Present technical designs, strategies, and roadmaps to executive stakeholders.
* Governance & Best Practices:
* Define standards and best practices for Salesforce development and implementation.
* Oversee data integrity, security, and compliance for Salesforce solutions.
* Implement DevOps and CI/CD pipelines for streamlined deployments.
* Team Development:
* Mentor and coach developers, administrators, and other technical team members.
* Foster a culture of knowledge sharing and collaboration within the customer environment.

**Required Qualifications**
**Experience, Skills and Qualifications Required**

* Experience:
* 10+ years of Salesforce experience, including 5+ years in a Solution Architecture or Technical Architect capacity.
* Hands-on expertise in Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Field Service Lightning (FSL).
* Proven experience in designing and delivering complex Salesforce solutions for large-scale implementations.
* Technical Skills:
* Strong proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs.
* Solid understanding of Salesforce configuration, security models, and integration patterns.
* Experience with custom development, system integrations, and AppExchange products.
* Certifications:
* Multiple Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Certified Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform Developer I & II, Application Architect, or System Architect.
* Soft Skills:
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for working with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with industry-specific implementations in domains like Retail, Manufacturing, or Payments.
* Familiarity with Field Service Lightning best practices, including scheduling and optimization.
* Knowledge of agile methodologies and tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps.

**Compensation**
Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Executive Deal Sponsorship: Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization: Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM: Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* Deal & Technical Escalation: Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* Architectural & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) prior to contract signature.
* Strategic Product Advocacy: Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* AI/Automation Acumen: Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* Comprehensive Core Networking: Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* Advanced Wireless & 5G: Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* Voice/UC Expertise: Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* Cloud Computing Expertise: Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Architect
description:
**Description**
Senior Architect
  
  
Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**
Desired Qualifications:
  
  

* 12+ years of overall IT experience in software development and architecture.
* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure.
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in an Application Architect/Solution Architect role.
* Proven experience designing cloud-native applications using Azure and microservices architecture.
* Strong expertise in API-driven architectures, distributed systems, and enterprise application design.
* Experience leading end-to-end solution delivery from architecture through implementation.
* Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams of 7–10+ developers.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Azure Solutions Architect Expert Certification (AZ-305 or equivalent).
* Clinical, Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or GxP-regulated environment experience.
* Knowledge of Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
* Experience with application modernization and enterprise integrations.

**Job description & Overview:**
Architecture & Solution Design
  
  

* Lead design of complex enterprise and cloud-native architectures.
* Define architecture patterns including microservices, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and specifications.
* Drive application modernization and migration strategies.

Azure Cloud Architecture
  
  

* Design solutions using Azure services such as App Services, Functions, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, and Key Vault.
* Architect secure, scalable, and cost-optimized cloud environments.
* Implement identity and access management using Azure AD, SSO, OAuth/OpenID.
* Enable monitoring, logging, and observability frameworks.

Technical Leadership & Governance
  
  

* Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams.
* Ensure adherence to architectural standards and best practices.
* Define governance frameworks and reusable architecture patterns.
* Lead and mentor engineering teams

DevOps & Integration
  
  

* Drive CI/CD and DevOps practices using Azure DevOps and GitHub.
* Design enterprise integration using APIs and messaging systems.
* Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, and security requirements.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Innovation
  
  

* Collaborate with business stakeholders to align solutions with objectives.
* Contribute to proposals, roadmaps, and technical strategy.

**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com
  
  
**Additional Information**
Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
  
  
**Summary**
The Senior Architect is responsible for leading the design, development, and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. The role provides technical leadership across programs and defines architectural direction aligned with business objectives. The architect leverages deep expertise in Azure cloud architecture, microservices, and modern DevOps practices to build cloud-native and hybrid solutions. The role also focuses on modernizing legacy systems, enabling enterprise integration, and driving innovation while mentoring engineering teams.

title: Lead Engineer - Cloud Engineering
description:
**About Us**
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
  
  
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
  
  
**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
**About the Role**
We are looking for a hands-on AWS Lead Engineer to lead cloud modernization, engineering excellence, and AI-driven innovation for our Provider Payments platform. This role will work across all Provider Engineering Pods, driving scalable solutions, reusable capabilities, and modernization of healthcare payment systems while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of secure, scalable, cloud-native solutions on AWS.
* Drive modernization of .NET applications into microservices and event-driven architectures.
* Partner across all Provider Engineering Pods to establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices.
* Champion AI-driven engineering practices to improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, observability, and operational efficiency.
* Influence technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and cloud transformation initiatives.
* Mentor engineers and promote a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security, and Operations teams to deliver business outcomes.
* Drive operational excellence through automation, reliability engineering, and proactive monitoring.

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong AWS experience with EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, IAM, and VPC.
* Deep expertise in.NET Core / .NET 6+, C#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Domain-Driven Design, and API-first development.
* Experience with SQL Server, NoSQL databases, messaging platforms, and high-volume transaction systems.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform/CloudFormation, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Knowledge of cloud security, authentication, authorization, and secure engineering practices.
* Experience building highly available and resilient payment platforms.

**AI-Driven Engineering Mindset**

* Passion for leveraging AI and GenAI tools to accelerate software development lifecycle activities.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, code reviews, documentation, and engineering productivity.
* Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve operational efficiency, developer experience, and platform intelligence.
* Drive a culture of experimentation, automation, and data-driven decision making.
* Curiosity to continuously learn emerging AI capabilities and apply them responsibly within engineering teams.

Domain Experience
  
  
**Preferred Experience In**

* Provider Payments
* Healthcare Claims
* Payment Integrity
* Revenue Cycle Management
* Healthcare Financial Platforms

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Ownership mindset with strong accountability.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence across teams without direct authority.
* Growth mindset and passion for mentoring others.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving results.
* Customer-focused with a bias for action and execution excellence.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 8-12 years of software engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience in AWS and .NET technologies.
* Experience leading cloud modernization and large-scale engineering initiatives.
* Agile delivery experience and strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
* AWS certifications preferred.

Ideal Candidate: A technology leader with deep AWS and .NET expertise, healthcare payment domain knowledge, an AI-first engineering mindset, and the ability to influence and collaborate across all Provider Engineering Pods while living Zelis' IMPACT values.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

**What You’ll Be Doing...**
This role requires a visionary technology leader who will champion the integration of Generative AI technologies into our projects. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise to drive innovation, enhance product offerings, and create efficient solutions that align with our strategic goals.
  
  

* AI Architecture, Agentic Systems & MLOps
* Agentic Workflows & Digital Workers: Design and operationalize GenAI-powered agents, LLMs, RAG, and multi-agent frameworks that function as digital workers—automating complex decision-making for CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), ordering, orchestration, inventory, and service assurance.

* Foundation Model Management: Integrate state-of-the-art foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source via Hugging Face/vLLM) while managing model routing, latency budgets, token cost optimization, and semantic caching.
* LLMOps & Governance: Establish MLOps/LLMOps pipelines featuring real-time model monitoring, fine-tuning, safety guardrails, automated CI/CD deployments, and evaluation pipelines (e.g., LangSmith, Phoenix) to guarantee output quality, security, and compliance.
* Full Stack & Distributed Systems Architecture
* End-to-End Systems Engineering: Oversee the architectural blueprint for web applications, microservices, and event-driven asynchronous pipelines across frontend, backend, and cloud environments.
* High-Performance Frontends: Architect dynamic, real-time user interfaces capable of streaming response handling (Server-Sent Events / WebSockets) and dynamic AI UI components. NodeJS, Angular is a must.
* API & Microservices Design: Build robust, highly concurrent, low-latency APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and microservice layers powering critical enterprise workflows.
* Cloud, Data Engineering & Analytics
* Multi-Cloud & Streaming Strategy: Build and scale data analytics and real-time streaming pipelines across cloud environments (AWS, GCP) to handle high-throughput customer, partner, and employee transactions.
* Data Persistence Models: Architect hybrid data persistence frameworks combining relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, DynamoDB), and high-precision vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector).
* Ingestion Pipelines: Design data ingestion, chunking, and embedding workflows to transform unstructured organizational knowledge into high-precision search platforms.
* Technical Leadership, Execution & Stakeholder Management
* Engineering Standards & Roadmaps: Set technical roadmaps, architectural standards, API contracts, and design patterns across global engineering squads.
* Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner closely with Product Management, Partner Solutions, Public Sector, and Technology Transformation teams to translate complex customer RFPs, migrations, and product goals into engineering blueprints.
* Delivery & Global Team Management: Direct software execution across hybrid onshore, offshore, and vendor IT teams using Agile and DevOps methodologies to maximize engineering velocity and throughput.
* Validation & Iterative Review: Lead technical reviews and demos with stakeholders to validate feature alignment against policy and operational constraints, rapidly integrating user feedback into system specs.
* Leading the technology charter for the development, engineering and solutioning using the latest technology stack infusing AI into the product development
* Innovating

+ Championing the adoption of Generative AI technologies across the organization.
+ Identifing emerging trends and opportunities in AI and propose innovative solutions.
+ Conducting workshops and training sessions to educate team members on Generative AI technologies and best practices

* Performance Monitoring and Improvement:

+ Establishing metrics to evaluate the performance and effectiveness of AI solutions.
+ Continuously assessing and optimize AI models and algorithms for better accuracy and efficiency.
+ Ensuring that AI implementations adhere to ethical standards and regulatory requirements.
+ Advocating for responsible AI practices within the organization.
+ Developing highly-available applications and service stacks in production environments.
+ Providing architectural oversight for systems and services
+ Promoting, implementing, and educating about Agile software development
+ Staying updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive continuous improvement
+ Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of development efforts with business objectives
+ Bringing in new ideas towards unlocking the unarticulated needs of our customers in the Digital channels infusing AI
+ Delivering on the AGILE KPI’s and driving incremental improvements on Quality, Supply Demand Capacity, on time completion of milestones and positive business outcomes

**What We’re Looking For...**
You have the ability to define a vision and your ambitious attitude drives you to generate highly innovative ideas and take calculated risks. You develop positive relationships and innovative solutions, which makes you a productive collaborator. Customers appreciate that you take personal responsibility for their satisfaction, and team members know they can count on your commitment.
  
  
**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Six or more years of relevant work experience.
* Proven experience as an AI architect or similar role, with a focus on Generative AI
* Technical Skills
* Proficiency in programming languages (Python, Java, etc.).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and AI services.
* Software development experience in a diverse set of areas including scalable web applications
* Experience in Java/J2EE application development including experience leading a technical team in such web technologies.
* Experience in a DevOps software development environment.
* Experience migrating web applications to Cloud (AWS, Oracle Cloud or Cloud Foundry etc.)
* Knowledge and experience of Docker/Container technologies
* Exceptional communication and collaboration skills.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.
* Ability to lead and inspire teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong background in machine learning, deep learning, and AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* A degree in computer science or computer engineering.

* Innovation mindset
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills ability to assimilate data from varied sources, apply deductive reasoning and scientific method, make inferences, draw testable conclusions, and resolve problems.

* Experience in building large scale systems-management, network monitoring systems, and monitoring applications.

title: Team Lead - Software Engineering
description:
**About Us**
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.

**Position Overview**

Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards
  
  
Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and delivery commitments
  
  
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, QA, SRE, and Compliance
  
  
**Required Technical Skills**
Core Technologies
  
  
Strong expertise in C#, .NET Core / .NET 6+
  
  
ASP.NET Core Web APIs & Microservices
  
  
RESTful services and event-driven architectures
  
  
Payments & Data
  
  
Strong SQL Server experience (complex queries, performance tuning)

title: Manager II, Tech(AI)
description:
**Overview**
 BEST is modernizing our data capabilities to accelerate product innovation, data\-driven decision making, and AI\-enabled experiences. Today the organization operates with traditional data engineering practices; we are hiring a transformation leader who will modernize the platform, build production\-grade ML/AI capabilities, and embed responsible AI across the business.
   

  

 We’re hiring a strategic, hands\-on
 **Sr. Manager, Data Services** 
 to own and scale BEST’s data platform and teams—leading engineers and managers across ingestion, transformation, platform services, data products/APIs, governance, and production ML/AI. You’ll be accountable for MLOps, model serving, and the people/processes to safely operationalize AI at scale, transforming a traditional data\-engineering function into an AI\-first, product\-oriented organization. This role requires deep technical expertise in data platforms, MLOps and LLM/AI patterns, plus proven people leadership and cross\-functional influence.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Strategy \& Roadmap — Define and operationalize a 12–24 month roadmap for Data Services that supports company data and AI goals (data APIs, platform, governance, ML pipelines, model serving and monitoring).
* Team Leadership — Hire, mentor and grow a high\-performing team (data engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, SREs). Build leadership bench and establish clear career paths.
* Data Platform Ownership — Own the design, delivery, and run\-book for data platforms (data lake/warehouse, streaming, ingestion, processing, metadata/catalog, lineage and observability).
* ML/AI Enablement — Partner with AI/ML teams to build repeatable ML pipelines and production model serving (batch \& real\-time). Lead MLOps adoption: model training, deployment, CI/CD, drift detection, and model governance.
* AI Productionization — Drive production\-grade implementations of AI use\-cases (including large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, agentic/automated workflows). Ensure safe, scalable, and cost\-efficient model serving and inference.
* Data Products \& APIs — Deliver production data products and APIs consumed by analytics, product teams, and AI systems. Enable self\-service data and ML capabilities for downstream teams.
* Quality, Observability \& Governance — Implement enterprise\-grade data quality, lineage, cataloging, access controls, and privacy/compliance practices. Partner with security and legal on policy for AI model usage and data privacy.
* Stakeholder Management — Work cross\-functionally with product, engineering, marketing, sales, and COE to translate business needs into data and AI programs, prioritizing high\-impact work and measuring outcomes.
* Metrics \& Outcomes — Define and report KPIs for platform reliability, time\-to\-insight, model accuracy/performance, cost, and adoption.


**Qualifications**
* 12\+ years’ experience in data engineering, data platform, analytics, or ML engineering roles, with at least 3\+ years in a people\-/team\-management role.
* Hands\-on experience building and operating large\-scale data platforms (data lakes/warehouses, Spark/Databricks, Snowflake/Redshift/BigQuery, streaming with Kafka/Kinesis).
* Demonstrated track record of taking ML/AI projects from POC to production. Practical experience with MLOps tooling and pipelines (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or equivalent).
* Deep familiarity with model serving and inference architectures (real\-time and batch), model monitoring, automated retraining, and drift detection.
* Strong engineering skills: Python / SQL (and/or Scala/Java), data pipeline frameworks, and versioned data/model workflows.
* Experience with LLMs and modern AI application patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, LLM safety/guardrails, and LLMOps frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Cloud platform experience (AWS / Azure / GCP) and experience designing cost\-efficient, production\-grade ML inference at scale.
* Experience with data governance, cataloging (Amundsen/Atlas/Data Catalog), lineage and privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA) in a production environment.
* Excellent people and cross\-functional leadership skills, with strong communication, stakeholder influence, and program management ability.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field. Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in a quantitative or engineering discipline preferred.

title: Global Senior Domain Solution Architect Enterprise Platforms
description:

As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally. Join us, the future is ours to shape!
   

  

 We are looking for a Global Senior Domain Solution Architect, Enterprise Platforms, to lead the architecture and evolution of shared technology platforms that enable enterprise workflow, automation, cloud\-native application capabilities, DevOps, IT service management, and reusable cross\-functional services. This role ensures enterprise platforms are scalable, secure, compliant, cost\-efficient, and aligned with business strategy and enterprise architecture principles.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Contribute to the development and evolution of the target architecture, technology roadmap, and reusable architecture standards for shared enterprise platforms, including workflow and service management, automation, DevOps, low\-code/no\-code, cloud platform services, and other reusable technology capabilities.
* Develop solution architectures for the implementation, modernization, consolidation, integration, and continuous evolution of platforms within the Enterprise Platforms domain.
* Deliver architecture services, governance activities, architecture modeling, and documentation across global programs, projects, product teams, and platform initiatives, including conceptual and logical architectures, platform blueprints, capability maps, technology standards, and architecture decision records.
* Define and apply reusable architecture patterns, principles, standards, and reference architectures to improve platform consistency, interoperability, scalability, reuse, and long\-term maintainability.
* Evaluate platform capabilities, identify technology gaps and functional overlaps, and provide recommendations regarding platform adoption, modernization, consolidation, rationalization, or retirement.
* Support platform ownership and product teams in defining platform boundaries, shared services, technology roadmaps, lifecycle strategies, and non\-functional requirements while promoting platform reuse, standardization, automation, and self\-service capabilities.
* Ensure platform architectures meet enterprise requirements for cybersecurity, data privacy, resilience, availability, business continuity, disaster recovery, GxP, and other applicable regulatory, quality, and compliance frameworks.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure and Cloud, Data and Analytics, Integration, SAP, business application teams, vendors, and implementation partners to ensure architectural alignment, validate platform capabilities, and advise on emerging technologies and platform innovations relevant to Sandoz.


**Key Performance Indicator**
* Consistent, well\-governed, secure, resilient, and cost\-effective enterprise platform architectures supported by documented target architectures, technology roadmaps, standards, reusable architecture patterns, increased platform reuse and standardization, reduced technology duplication, and clearly defined ownership boundaries.


**Essential Requirements**
**What You'll Bring to the Role:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; master's degree preferred.
* 5\+ years of IT experience, including experience in solution, platform, domain, or enterprise architecture roles.
* Experience designing, governing, or evolving shared enterprise technology platforms within complex global organizations.
* Practical experience with enterprise platform technologies, including IT service management, enterprise workflow, automation, low\-code/no\-code, DevOps, cloud application platforms, container platforms, and developer enablement capabilities.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture concepts, including platform\-as\-a\-service, container orchestration, cloud\-native application services, identity and access management, observability, resilience, shared cloud services, and hybrid technology environments.
* Understanding of DevOps and software delivery capabilities, including source code management, CI/CD, artifact management, automated testing, infrastructure as code, platform engineering practices, and modern application delivery approaches.
* Ability to define platform boundaries, identify capability overlaps, translate business and technology requirements into scalable platform architectures and roadmaps, and apply architecture tools and modeling techniques such as ArchiMate, UML, BPMN, and SAP LeanIX.
* Knowledge of non\-functional architecture requirements, including cybersecurity, privacy, availability, performance, scalability, interoperability, business continuity, disaster recovery, supportability, applicable regulatory and quality frameworks (including GxP, data integrity, data privacy, and computerized system lifecycle requirements), combined with strong consulting, stakeholder management, communication, and enterprise architecture skills; fluent in English.


**Desirable Requirements**
* Experience working across SaaS, PaaS, cloud, and on\-premises environments, collaborating with application, data, integration, security, infrastructure, and operations teams.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, life sciences, or other highly regulated industries.

* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* Flexible and hybrid working opportunities.
* Ongoing learning, professional development, and certification support.
* Exposure to global security and technology initiatives.
* Career growth opportunities within a dynamic and evolving global organization.
* An inclusive, collaborative, and purpose\-driven work environment.

 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
